name.ja: 回復アイテムの効き方

description.en: Records what actually happens when a healing item is used: which popup entry was pressed and what the popup holds (the `usable` flag), the real `usable` handed to ItemConsumeManager.consume_item, the before/after of HP, stamina, their caps and status on the player and on the item's owner, the text lines added meanwhile, who calls Item.consume, the pure functions get_heal_spec / get_heal_physical_integrity_barden / get_max_physical_integrity, and the cap updates. Reading only
description.ja: 回復アイテムを使ったとき実際に何が起きるかを録る。右クリックのどの項目が押されたかと popup の中身（`usable` 相当）、ItemConsumeManager.consume_item に渡る `usable` の実値、プレイヤーと品の持ち主の HP・スタミナ・上限・status の前後、その間に足された文、Item.consume を誰が呼ぶか、純関数 get_heal_spec / get_heal_physical_integrity_barden / get_max_physical_integrity の対応表、上限の更新。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない

note.ja: 右クリックの押下と、使用の前後の差分。0 にすると録らない
note.en: Popup presses and before/after diffs of a use. 0 = do not record

label.en: How many distinct pure calls to record

note.ja: 同じ引数の組は1度しか書かない。0 にすると録らない
note.en: Each distinct set of arguments is written once. 0 = do not record

label.ja: 使用の外の上限更新を写す件数
label.en: Cap updates to record outside a use

note.ja: レベルアップや日送りで走る update_max_hp / update_max_physical_integrity。使用の間は数に入れず毎回書く
note.en: update_max_hp / update_max_physical_integrity fired by level-ups or day passing. Calls during a use are always written and not counted
